lines.t: Come, all who know not my ways, I will show you
Come, all who have been abandoned, I will comfort you and give you shelter
Come, all who are crippled, let us run and leap for joy together
Come, all who are faithless, I shall fill your cup and watch it overflow Come, all who blaspheme, I will give you a new voice
Bring home all who are blind and deaf, for they too shall see and hear

May your new clothes hang upon the tree
